asst_warrants.label: PIPE (traditional) warrants
asst_warrants.note: Exercise deadline moved from Oct 12 (Columbus Day) to 5:00 pm ET Oct 13. Outstanding count comes from each weekly filing (traditional_warrant_shares).

strategy_reserve_floor_months.note: Strategy's USD Reserve policy: not below 12 months of dividends without board approval (digital credit capital framework).

strive_reserve_goal_months.note: Strive's dashboard reports an 18-month dividend reserve every week; the panel reads cover against that goal.

spread_benchmark.label: 3M bill
spread_benchmark.note: Headline spread benchmark for STRC and SATA. Strategy defines its risk-free rate as the 3-month Treasury yield; Jeff Walton benchmarks digital credit against T-bills ("A three-month T-Bill") while calling it moderate-duration credit; both securities reset monthly around $100 par. Options: SOFR, 3M bill, 10Y, IG corp, HY corp.
